data.content_ref: inline:Reframe grounded semantics as the least model of a Horn program whose predicates are `accepted/1`, `defeated/1`, and `attacks/2`, with rules such as `defeated(A) :- accepted(D), attacks(D,A)` and `accepted(X) :- not attacked_by_undefeated(X)` encoded via auxiliary predicates. Then compute the least model using unit propagation in polynomial time. Strengthen the extension by adding integrity constraints that reject any model where a committed root lacks a derivation; these constraints are checked during propagation, not after, so no invalid root is ever committed. Criticism: Horn encodings of non-monotonic defeat require extra negated predicates and may not preserve the exact grounded semantics unless carefully stratified.
